name: Baseline sustainability assessment

regulatory_anchors.regulation: FCA Policy Statement PS23/16: Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) and investment labels
regulatory_anchors.article: Chapter 4: Sustainability labels (paragraphs 4.28-4.31 — Sustainability Improvers requires measurable baseline against which improvement is assessed)

summary: Tests whether current performance metrics are measured at the asset to establish the baseline against which improvement is assessed. PS23/16 ¶4.28 requires Sustainability Improvers products to demonstrate measurable improvement; PB methodology v3.5 requires baseline values for three core data-centre metrics (current PUE, current renewable energy %, current GHG Scope 1+2) — the minimum set needed to verify an improvement trajectory is real rather than aspirational.
